span.p:
Roomora uses a layered architecture with clear separation of concerns:
1. Presentation — SwiftUI Views (declarative UI)
2. State Management — @Observable ViewModels + Environment injection
3. Services — Singleton API client with Bearer token auth
4. Backend — Rails REST API on PostgreSQL
Design patterns: Observer (reactive state), MVVM (separation of concerns),
Singleton (shared services), Coordinator (onboarding flow),
Environment DI (dependency injection without prop drilling)
